findings.text: non-blocking: _attempt_ending_receipt re-reads the two exit receipts by hand with _read_reservation instead of calling reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:1534 _run_exit_record, which dispatch_launch.py:2170 already uses for the same attempt receipt; it duplicates that owner, drops its run-id check, and two readers of one receipt can diverge.

non-blocking: _DELIVERED_RUN_PHASES restates a subset of reckon/crew/node.py:35 _TERMINAL_RUN_PHASES, which dispatch_launch.py:47 already imports, so a terminal phase added to the owner will not join the copy, and the copy is the set whose member the guard trusts without a receipt.
non-blocking: the header names revision 18d133b4 although the arm ran on the worktree's uncommitted new bytes, so the arm cannot be told from the base-bytes run by its header.
non-blocking: the fragment names efff4c70fb for the after arm while logs/after-suite.log:1 records f57ec4874b; the code bytes are identical, but the document names a revision its own log does not.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to keep a resumed repair from being killed as a terminal run; reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:4825-4842 requires the attempt's own exit receipt before a stored complete word counts as its completion.
